Sohair El-Geziry
The center's atmosphere is professional and friendly. The vets have a lot of experience and it's clear that they work hard and love what they do; very patient, as well, as they pay attention to every detail we mention and are very knowledgeable. Definitely recommended👍
Hazel Cortez
American Vet Center in Zamalek truly stands out as a sanctuary for pets and their owners. The team of doctors is nothing short of extraordinary. They are not only highly professional but also deeply compassionate, showing genuine care for every animal that comes through their doors. Whether it’s a routine check-up or an emergency, you can see their passion and dedication in the way they handle each case with expertise and kindness.
The clinic itself is immaculate, setting a new standard for cleanliness and hygiene. Every piece of equipment and tool they use is spotless, ensuring the highest level of safety and comfort for your pets. It’s evident that they prioritize both the health of the animals and the peace of mind of their owners.
What makes American Vet Center truly special is their ability to combine professionalism with a heartfelt love for animals. You can trust that your furry friends are in the best hands possible. Highly recommended for anyone seeking top-notch veterinary care in Zamalek.
Jimmy Elshazly
Thanks to the AVC team in Maadi for saving my cat’s life. I truly appreciate their professionalism and highly recommend them to anyone who cares about his furry pet.
